Solve this Python programming problem.

Write a python function to remove first and last occurrence of a given character from the string.

Your code must pass tests like this one:
assert remove_Occ("hello","l") == "heo"

Reply with the complete solution in a single ```python code block. Include any imports it needs. Don't include the tests.
text:
```python
def remove_Occ(s, ch):
    # Find the first occurrence of the character
    first_occurrence = s.find(ch)
    # If the character is found, remove it
    if first_occurrence != -1:
        s = s[:first_occurrence] + s[first_occurrence + 1:]
    
    # Find the last occurrence of the character
    last_occurrence = s.rfind(ch)
    # If the character is found, remove it
    if last_occurrence != -1:
        s = s[:last_occurrence] + s[last_occurrence + 1:]
    
    return s
```
